name: Estazolam
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: Hepatic CYP3A hydroxylation forms 4-hydroxyestazolam, with other oxidation products also present. Metabolites have low potency and concentrations; elimination is mainly urinary as free/conjugated metabolites.
